title: Decode Ways
description: Determine the number of ways to decode a string of digits into letters (1='A', 26='Z').

steps.note: Initialize DP array of size 4 with zeros
Base case: empty string has 1 way
Base case: first digit '2' is valid, 1 way
Single digit '2' is > 0, add dp[1] to dp[2]
Two digits '22' is between 10-26, add dp[0] to dp[2]
Single digit '6' is > 0, add dp[2] to dp[3]
Two digits '26' is between 10-26, add dp[1] to dp[3]
